heading: Fugitives from justice
lead: No statute of limitations shall extend to any person fleeing from justice.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on Title 18, U.S.C., 1940 ed., § 583 (R.S. § 1045). Said section 583 was rephrased and made applicable to all statutes of limitation and is merely declaratory of the generally accepted rule of law.
